key_insight: A diffeomorphic PET/CT registration pipeline was tailored to preserve PSMA PET quantification while aligning longitudinal whole-body scans.
clinical_relevance: By better preserving lesion uptake metrics like MTV and TLG during image alignment, the approach may support more reliable longitudinal assessment of treatment response in PSMA PET/CT.
method: Affine pre-registration followed by coarse-to-fine multi-modal deformable registration using LapIRN
Test-time instance optimization to adapt the model per case
PET biomarker preservation losses for MTV/TLG plus Jacobian-based constraints and skeletal rigidity regularization
evidence_signal: On the reported evaluation protocol, the submitted system achieved 81.0% DSC, 6.17 mm HD95, and 3.3% error for both MTV and TLG.
watch_item: Performance is reported on a challenge evaluation protocol, so robustness and generalizability to other scanners, cohorts, and clinical workflows still need validation.
paper_title: PET Quantification-Preserving Registration for Longitudinal Whole-Body PSMA PET/CT
